evidence.quote: - Reviewer 1: #5, line 203-208. Did you analyze the statistical properties of all the investigated variables including skewness, kurtosis, and outlier. Skipped these basic examinations before main analyses may cause systematic errors.

-According to reviewer 1, we have included skewness and kurtosis in the Table 1. Only depersonalization showed high kurtosis, therefore, for despersonalization, Spearman correlation (which are more appropriate dealing with non-normally distributed data) were computed to specify the relationship between depersonalisation and the rest of variables. Also Mahalanobis distance was computed to determine if multivariate outliers occurred in the dataset. One participant was found to be outlier (p<.001), being removed from the dataset. (see lines from 217-230).
